Bits 9-15 unused. e2m EPO3DXEN calls bit 4 oil temperature but this build has no oil temperature channel; v64t6_s also files MXLPANEA (mask 8) here though the code reads it in word 25. Bench 0x0000. proposal.notes:
Method: every abs.l reference to 0x803cc6-0x803cd7 in J90350.00.rom.bin (scratch hits68k.py), each hand-decoded. All 20 are move.w (abs).l,d0 + andi #single-bit-mask + branch. No writes, no odd-byte (btst) or long accesses, no tst. Indexed accesses from word 0 (movea.l #0x803c94,a0) reach only words 7-9 (bit 112+4n), words 13-14 (logical switch + 0xd0, cm550_FUN_000206a8 / cm550_FUN_00020890) and word 26 (bit 416+n, the two derate loops). llvm-mc-18 drops clr / addq / andi / moveq on m68k and loses address sync, so it is not reliable for whole functions here.

'No test' always means none in the dumped 256 KB. 109 call targets above 0x40000 are undumped, and the bench EEPROM sets bits nothing in the dump tests: word 25 0x0180, word 27 bit 13, word 32 bits 6 / 12 / 13.

Bench EEPROM and RAM mirror agree: w25 0x0180, w26 0, w27 0x2010, w28 0, w32 0xf241, w33 0. The length word 0x803c92 reads 0x46 (70 bytes = words 0-34).

e2m quirks:
- v64t6_s (and every 5x/6x e2m) files MXLPANEA under +0x36. The code and the 7x/8x files say +0x34.
- EPO3DXEN (word 26 bit 4, 'oil temperature') does not match the code's channel table: channel 4 is water in fuel, and v64t6_s has no EPO3 block.
- Word 27's AHEN / TBAMEN / TBSPTMEN / TUWGEN / TUWGOVEN N records carry two bit numbers (5-9 and 11-15). I followed 5-9 (the leading number and every S-record mask). No CM550 code reads either set.

Judgment calls the orchestrator can overrule cheaply:
- Word 27 is cm550_ only because bits 11-13 have no J90350.00 proof. They match CM848 in 18 later ISB e2m files.
- Word 28 bit 4 is named from the e2m group header 'INTEGRATED IDLE MANAGEMENT'. TAS is never spelled out.
- Word 32 bit 7 (IHMREN) is reserved because its mnemonic and description disagree.
- Word 33 bit 4 uses CM848's word-13 name for the same ADEBLVOD function.

No CM848 renames. CM848 word 28 reserved_bit_4 could add the ISTAEN guess to its comment: 27 ISB e2m files have 0x10, but CM848 itself has no record and no reader there.

Misname and twin leads (not renamed here):
- vp44SensorStatusMonitor (0x1d9b4) is the idle shutdown state machine: gated by word 3 bit 1 ISAGEN, suppressed by word 28 bit 4, and state 5 sets engine_shutdown_command_flag. Its _vp44_sensor_* globals are the idle shutdown timers.
- cm550_FUN_0002041c / cm550_FUN_00020380 / cm550_FUN_000205c4 are the twins of cm848_processJ1939EngineFanRequestedSpeed / cm848_processJ1939EngineRetarderSelection / cm848_updateIdleSwitchesFromLocalInputs.
- cm550_FUN_00019702 is the fault derate fuel-limit twin of cm550_calculateFaultDerateEngineSpeedLimit.
- cm550_rpmLoadParameterLookup and vp44OperatingConditionChecker are the misfire timing limit (e2m BSTA*).
- cm550_fuelTimingTransitionStateMachine computes the AFC derate fuel adjustment.
- vp44_FUN_00025a34 is the low speed governor integrator preset.
